name: Mobile App Development
headline: Apps people keep on their home screen.
intro: Native-quality Android and iOS apps, designed around how your customers actually use their phones and engineered to stay fast, secure and easy to maintain.

overview.what: Mobile app development covers the full journey of an app: product thinking, interface design, engineering for Android and iOS, backend and API integration, store release and long-term support.
overview.why: For most customers the phone is the first and often only screen they use. A well-built app puts your service one tap away, enables push notifications, offline use, camera, location and payments, and builds a direct relationship that a website alone cannot.
problems: Apps that look fine in a demo but lag, crash or drain battery on real devices
Separate Android and iOS builds that drift apart and double the maintenance cost
Launches that stall in store review because of policy, privacy or permission mistakes
Backends that cannot cope once real users and real data arrive
overview.approach: We start with the one job the app must do well, prototype it on real devices early, and build the app and its backend together so performance, security and release readiness are designed in rather than patched on.

deliver.d: Production apps for both platforms, built with native or cross-platform tooling depending on what your product needs.
Screens, navigation and micro-interactions that follow each platform's conventions and feel natural in one hand.
Secure REST or GraphQL services, authentication, data storage and admin tools that power the app.
Listing assets, privacy declarations, signing and review handling for Google Play and the App Store.
Device-matrix testing, automated checks and performance profiling before every release.
OS-version support, crash monitoring, security patches and feature releases after launch.

capabilities.d: Flutter and React Native for shared code and faster delivery, Kotlin and Swift where deep platform features matter.
Local storage with background synchronisation so the app stays useful on poor or intermittent networks.
Targeted, permission-aware messaging, in-app prompts and deep links that bring users back to the right screen.
In-app purchases, UPI and card checkout, wallets and recurring billing integrated with your finance flow.
Camera and document capture, geolocation, maps, biometrics, Bluetooth and file handling.
Encrypted storage, certificate pinning, secure token handling and data-protection practices aligned with store policies.

process.d: We define users, the core journey and success measures, and agree what the first release includes.
Clickable prototypes are tested on real phones before engineering starts.
App and backend are developed in short cycles with a working build you can install every sprint.
Functional, performance and security testing across the Android and iOS versions your users run.
Store listings, staged rollout and monitoring so the release is observed from the first install.
Crash tracking, OS updates and a prioritised roadmap driven by usage data.

benefits.d: Notifications, saved preferences and one-tap actions raise repeat use compared with a mobile website.

benefits.t: One codebase where it makes sense
benefits.d: Cross-platform delivery lowers build and upkeep cost without giving up quality.
Offline handling and device testing keep the app usable on average phones and average networks.
Release hygiene and policy checks reduce rejections and rework.
A backend built for growth means new features and more users do not force a rewrite.

usecases.d: Customers browse availability, book, pay and receive reminders from a single app.
Staff capture photos, signatures and locations offline and sync when they reconnect.
Catalogues, wallets, offers and order tracking tied to your existing store systems.
Content, progress tracking and subscriptions delivered on any device.

cta.h: Have an app in mind? Let us shape it with you.
cta.p: Share the idea, the users and the timeline. We will come back with a clear scope, a recommended approach and a realistic plan.
